reply: I did not find the exact law. The best candidate I scored was NMSE 2.6e-3 (a t-linear/quadratic-plus-cubic-in-x,v model), and none of the structures I tried got below about 2.6e-3. The strongest signal is that acceleration drops with t, but the missing term is still unidentified.

best.code:
import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*t**2 + p[3]*x + p[4]*x**3 + p[5]*v + p[6]*v**3
            + p[7]*np.tanh(p[8]*v) + p[9]*x*v)
